title: Franco-Hova Wars
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Franco-Hova Wars", at revision 1371053924, opens: "The Franco-Hova Wars, also known as the Franco-Malagasy Wars, were two French military interventions in Madagascar between 1883 and 1896 that overthrew the ruling monarchy of the Merina Kingdom, and resulted in Madagascar becoming a French colony. The term "Hova" referred to a social class within the Merina class structure." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2638505, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1883–1896 pair of French colonial invasions of Madagascar". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
